items.comment: The source verb 'stipulates' introduces the standard formula rule; the rule content is represented by fact standard_index_formula_basis, so no separate stipulation predicate is needed.

The phrase 'taking into account' is represented by formula_level_change_takes_weight and formula_level_change_takes_currency_conversion; the token 'account' itself is not a separate methodology concept.
Discourse marker for an exception/branch; the branch condition is represented directly by the relevant implication/count formula.
The token 'other' is part of source phrases such as 'other distributions' and 'other than'; the semantic alternatives are already represented by Distribution and the currency inequality condition.
The source phrase 'other than the Index Currency' is represented by not (quoted_currency(component_price(c, d)) = index_currency(i)); 'than' is only the surface comparison marker.
The source phrase 'the so called ex-date' is represented by ex_date(p) = effective_date(p); 'called' is an alias marker rather than a separate claim.
The token 'such' points back to the same dividend/distribution payment already bound by payment_of(p, dist) and pays_distribution(c, dist).
The word 'more' only modifies 'detailed description'; the substantive cross-reference is represented by detailed_description_found_in(..., EquityIndexMethodologySection1_2).
The phrase 'can be found' is represented as the cross-reference detailed_description_found_in(..., EquityIndexMethodologySection1_2); 'can' does not add deontic or optional semantics here.
Scope preposition: absorbed into the guarded assignment/classification formulas rather than represented as a separate relation.
The phrase 'for the construction of' frames the decrement rules; the actual construction semantics are represented by underlying_index_of, decrement_of, deducted_from, and per-annum values.
Discourse/list marker: the following listed rules are represented by the constraints themselves.
The word 'Where' introduces the formula legend; each listed definition is represented by the formula, underlying-index links, synthetic-dividend value, and day-count fact.
